name: Ligeance Aerospace Technology Co.,Ltd.
summary: Ligeance Aerospace Technology Co.,Ltd. manufactures and sells aviation products in China and internationally. The company is involved in manufacturing, processing, assembly, and maintenance services for aerospace components. It also provides aircraft's wings, engine pylons, landing gear, and fuel pump housings, as well as wing spars, wing ribs, and wing surfaces, wing spars, ultra-large wing frames, fuselage frames, aircraft floor beams, seat rails, and cabin door assemblies used in wide-body and narrow-body commercial passenger aircraft.
